headlines.title: How the shooting death of a Houston father is igniting Latino politics in Texas
headlines.description: Lorenzo Salgado Araujo was killed on his way to work by ICE agents, who said he used his vehicle as a weapon. The community is demanding justice.

headlines.title: Poll: Latino voters swing away from Trump and Republicans
headlines.description: Democrats have a significant lead among Latino voters in 2026 amid economic concerns, according to the NBC News/Telemundo poll.

headlines.title: Can Democrats Mess With (Republican) Texas?
headlines.description: State Rep. Gina Hinojosa (D-TX) says the economy and jobs are more important than culture issues in the race for Texas Governor

headlines.title: U.S. bombers scrambled out of U.K. airbase after threats
headlines.description: The Pentagon is withdrawing all of its B-1 bombers from the RAF Fairford airbase in the U.K. The move, categorized by two officials as quick or rushed, comes just days after five men were arrested for a suspected terror plot involving vans containing explosives parked near the perimeter of the base. NBC News’ Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: The woman who alleges she was sexually assaulted by Cornell University fraternity members has received threats pressuring her to drop her lawsuit, her attorney said.

headlines.title: Could breakthrough new treatment cure Type 1 diabetes?
headlines.description: A groundbreaking clinical trial at the University of Chicago has potentially cured all 12 participants of Type 1 diabetes. The procedure involves transplanting cells on the pancreas - called islet cells - in combination with a new drug to prevent rejection. NBC News’ Anne Thompson has a closer look.

headlines.title: Cornell University police made drug arrest hours before alleged sexual assault
headlines.description: Cornell University police made a drug-related arrest at a fraternity house 22 hours before a former student alleges she was drugged and sexually assaulted there, according to a campus daily crime log reviewed by NBC. The log does not identify the drugs involved or establish any connection between the incidents. NBC News’ Valerie Castro reports.

headlines.title: Early indications suggest Flydubai co-pilot acted alone in attack, officials say
headlines.description: Early indications suggest the Flydubai co-pilot accused of attacking his captain and trying to seize control of an Israel-bound plane was a ‘lone wolf’ acting alone, rather than as part of a larger organization or on behalf of a foreign government, multiple U.S. officials briefed on the investigation and a former Israeli security official told NBC News. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez reports.

headlines.title: Ravens quarterback Lamar Jackson exits game vs. Titans with ankle injury
headlines.description: Jackson was tackled on the second-to-last play of the first half and didn’t return.

headlines.title: Who’s the best team in the NFC East? Through four weeks, it’s anyone’s guess
headlines.description: Who will win the NFC East? After games for the Giants, the Eagles and the Cowboys all went down to the final seconds in Week 4, no one has separated themselves yet.

headlines.title: Trump announces members of ‘Super Intelligence Force’ to coordinate AI policy
headlines.description: President Donald Trump announced the formation of an AI task force, naming National Intelligence Director Jay Clayton to lead it.

headlines.title: Affording America: How a single mother in Chicago turned to gig work to survive
headlines.description: Jade Crossfrench is a single mother supporting three children with a day job selling insurance. But that isn't enough to provide for her family. For over a year she's been making extra money as a gig worker, doing DoorDash food deliveries around Chicago, often with her kids sitting in the back seat of the car.
